integrity: Cartier matrix and parameter stratification are justified by symbolic polynomial identities over F_7, with a runnable exact checker. Source first-public date is 2006-12-21; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is limited to the characteristic-seven smooth cyclic family y^3=x^5+a*x^2+b, and does not determine generic Newton polygons or larger moduli spaces. Historical priority of an equivalent coordinate parametrization remains provisional.
title: Three-step p-rank stratification with constant a-number in a genus-four trigonal family
